prune_linear: prune a single PyTorch Linear layer using structured sparsity mask and optionally prune its bias
prune_linear_linear: prune two consecutive PyTorch Linear layers by removing pruned output features from the first and matching input features from the second
prune_linear_activation_linear: prune a Linear layer followed by an activation and a second Linear layer, propagating pruned biases to the next layer
prune_conv2d_conv2d: prune two consecutive PyTorch Conv2d layers by removing pruned output channels and adjusting the second layer input channels
prune_lstm_output_linear: prune an LSTM layer and its output Linear layer, splitting and resizing hidden-to-hidden weights per gate
